verdict.rationale: mise documents keeping multiple tool versions on one machine and having each project declare which version it uses, switching automatically by directory. That implies a machine-level install shared across projects rather than per-project copies (mise-docs-65, mise-docs-53, mise-docs-82). Nothing describes a content-addressable store, deduplication guarantees, or how dependencies are laid out on disk. Missing for 10: any documentation of a content-addressable store, explicit statement that one version is stored once and reused across projects, coverage of language-level dependencies beyond tool runtimes, independent corroboration of disk savings.
